# stalwart_spf_report_settings (Data Source)

Configures SPF authentication failure report generation. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `dkim_sign_domain` (Attributes) Which domain's DKIM signatures to use when signing the SPF authentication failure report (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dkim_sign_domain))
- `from_address` (Attributes) Email address that will be used in the From header of the SPF authentication failure report email (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--from_address))
- `from_name` (Attributes) Name that will be used in the From header of the SPF authentication failure report email (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--from_name))
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `send_frequency` (Attributes) Rate at which SPF reports will be sent to a given email address. When this rate is exceeded, no further SPF failure reports will be sent to that address (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--send_frequency))
- `subject` (Attributes) Subject name that will be used in the SPF authentication failure report email (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subject))
